name: FGAC.ai
description:
Connect Claude to Multiple Gmail Accounts, Work, School and Personal and let it update Google Sheets for you! Through FGAC.ai you can give Claude precise access to the specific sheets and senders you want.

More Google Workspace Connections Coming Soon!

_published_faq.name: How do I add FGAC.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add FGAC.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://fgac.ai/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the FGAC.ai MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: FGAC.ai lists 14 MCP tools, including get_my_permissions, gmail_get_attachment, gmail_labels, gmail_list, gmail_read, gmail_send, google_api_get, google_api_modify, list_accounts, request_access, sheets_append_rows, and sheets_get_spreadsheet.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to FGAC.ai?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to FGAC.ai in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
FGAC.ai requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
FGAC.ai is developed by FGAC.ai. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
